objective: Increase the locked 100-point gate's geometry/light-transport readiness by replacing the projecting stair tower's opaque fallback render mass with five physically open RC window apertures, while preserving gameplay collision and refusing visual credit without real Unity pixels.

discovery.sourceDefect: The generated StairTower is a single opaque 3.2 x 13.8 x 2.0 m cube spanning z=-7.35..-5.35. Facade optics disables the five opaque StairWindow renderers and creates transparent FO_StairGlass planes, while Danchi detail adds aluminum frame parts, but neither pass removes the opaque StairTower renderer or creates rough openings. The previous stair glass was centered around z=-5.284, in front of the tower front plane, so the stack read as glazing applied to a solid mass rather than a recessed installed window.
criticalDefectLinks: major light leak / invalid occlusion risk
discovery.constructionReference: YKK AP current RC sash installation references were used only for installation principle, not period-product identification: a distinct sash frame is fixed to an RC rough opening through anchors and perimeter sealing, and the cited RC non-welded method publishes a typical three-side frame-to-structure clearance of 25-35 mm. The generated fallback locks 30 mm per side around its existing 1.46 x 1.48 m stair frame.

implementation.lodPolicy: LOD0/1 retain four-sided seal geometry for every opening; LOD2/3 retain the identical macro RC rough-opening silhouette and optical depth while omitting the sub-pixel seals; animated cross-fade required.
implementation.materialPolicy: painted RC dielectric + aged anodized aluminum + EPDM/sealant + clear dielectric glass + matte non-emissive stairwell backing, with per-material albedo/roughness/metallic-F0/normal/microstructure/wetness/UV-aging/Fresnel metadata in the contract
implementation.gameplayPolicy: disable only StairTower Renderer; preserve its original Collider
implementation.antiPrimitivePolicy: all reconstructed RC shell pieces use persisted custom dimension-baked meshes, not Unity Cube/Cylinder/Sphere/Capsule renderer meshes
implementation.antiRepeatPolicy: RC UV0 is generated from absolute Danchi-local metric coordinates; the 2.4 m macro field therefore continues across separately constructed shell pieces instead of restarting 0..1 per opening/module

selfAuditCorrection.issueFound: The first shell topology made side/back/roof/base boxes occupy positive overlapping corner volumes and, critically, side walls and the full-depth front piers shared coplanar exterior strips at z=-5.35. That could create z-fighting in oblique/grazing evidence even though the rough openings themselves were valid.
selfAuditCorrection.fix: Added QualityBlockStairTowerShellJointQA. Side walls now end at the front-shell back plane, back wall fits between side returns, roof/base fit between side returns and between back/front shells, and corrected pieces use freshly persisted metric-UV custom meshes. The QA rejects positive-volume outer-shell joint overlap and verifies butt-plane continuity before reflection/capture and again before/after still evidence.
selfAuditCorrection.gatePolicy: No tolerance or Visual Fidelity minimum was relaxed to absorb the defect.
